method: HEAD-tree scan (sparse-safe git show/grep) + curated classification with live line recovery. Working-tree grep was not used as evidence of absence.
anti_goodhart: A 20% LOC reduction that leaves two Goal stores or two HCLI binaries unnamed is a failure. Optimise verified capability over line count. Ten science lanes are in flight against tools/headless and receipts/headless — this receipt is a plan, not a migration.
